decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to generate a massive amount of mana in order to cast spells and rituals quickly, leading up to a powerful storm combo finish. Cards like Jeska's Will, Rite of Flame, and Seething Song help to ramp up mana production, while Echo of Eons and Reforge the Soul provide card draw and potential hand refill. Additionally, Burning Wish allows for access to a wide variety of spells from the sideboard, enabling different win conditions or answers to opponent's threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells in a single turn for a game-winning lethal storm count.

The deck aims to quickly win through a powerful combo utilizing multiple spells to mill the opponent's entire library, before utilizing Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. It includes a mix of fast mana sources, creatures that can be sacrificed for various effects, and disruption spells to protect the combo. The deck is focused on executing its game plan as quickly and efficiently as possible, while also having some flexibility and resilience to disrupt opponents' strategies.

The deck is focused on utilizing the synergy between Mystic Forge, Voltaic Key, and Grim Monolith to generate a ton of mana and consistently cast powerful artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also includes powerful artifact lands like Urza's Tower and Urza's Workshop to fuel its explosive plays. The goal is to quickly assemble an overwhelming board state and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful artifacts and disruptive plays. The deck thrives on efficient mana generation and using it to establish control and dominate the game.

The deck focuses on quickly generating mana through rituals and mana sources like Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond in order to cast a high-impact spell like Ad Nauseam or Tendrils of Agony to win the game in a single turn. It also utilizes hand disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and find the necessary pieces. Burning Wish provides additional versatility and options for toolbox spells, while Past in Flames allows for a second chance to cast key spells from the graveyard. The deck aims to storm off and win the game before the opponent can set up their own game plan.

The main idea of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while efficiently controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck utilizes powerful control elements such as Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Kolaghan's Command to disrupt the opponent's plans, while also generating card advantage with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Cling to Dust. The deck also includes a mix of creatures like Baleful Strix and Snapcaster Mage to provide additional threats and value. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in order to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo using Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. It uses cards like Goblin Welder, Karn, the Great Creator, and Imperial Recruiter to tutor for combo pieces and protect the combo. The deck also runs disruptive cards like Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast to handle opposing threats, while utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal. The goal is to control the game until the combo is assembled and win in one explosive turn.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck aims to take advantage of cards like Omniscience and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to generate a significant advantage over the opponent. Through careful card selection with Ponder and Brainstorm, as well as disruption with cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful combos and threats.

This deck aims to quickly cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play using Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. By using various mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck can cast these high-cost creatures earlier than usual, overwhelming the opponent with their devastating abilities. The deck also includes protection spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier provide additional utility and control options to further solidify the deck's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to use aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf along with fast mana sources like City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb to quickly ramp into powerful spells such as Sundering Eruption and Blood Moon. The deck also utilizes cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to further accelerate its game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Cursed Mirror and The One Ring provide additional value and utility to deal with a variety of threats. Overall, this deck aims to apply fast and relentless pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of countermagic, hand disruption, and removal spells while deploying efficient threats to pressure the opponent. The key strategy involves controlling the board early on with cards like Fatal Push and Daze, while utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Nihil Spellbomb to disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard. Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters serve as powerful threats that can close out the game quickly if left unchecked, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and selection to keep the pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze, the deck aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from executing their strategy effectively. At the same time, cards like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf provide a clock to close out the game quickly. This deck also features efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Dismember to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to tempo out the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Lion's Eye Diamond, and then cast multiple spells in the same turn to create a storm count. The deck utilizes cards like Burning Wish to search for key pieces like Tendrils of Agony to finish off the opponent. Song of Creation and Gaea's Will provide additional ways to generate mana and draw cards, while Veil of Summer protects the combo from disruption. The deck focuses on manipulating the graveyard and casting spells efficiently to win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Spirit of the Labyrinth and Magus of the Moon while using Aether Vial and Stoneforge Mystic to bring out powerful creatures and equipment. It also utilizes flicker effects to gain value from creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Recruiter of the Guard. The deck's game plan is to apply pressure early with aggressive creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Mother of Runes, while controlling the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' game plan and overwhelm them with its powerful creatures and disruptive elements.

The main concept of this Aggro - Dimir Tempo deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures and removal spells. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's hand, combined with efficient threats like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by bouncing opponent's threats, removing key creatures, and countering important spells, all while applying pressure with evasive threats and card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student.

The deck focuses on quickly dropping powerful dragon creatures onto the battlefield along with disruptive spells like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon to lock down opponents' lands. Cards like The One Ring and Laelia, the Blade Reforged provide additional buffs to your creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sundering Eruption help control the board. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with aggressive plays and control the game with powerful creatures and disruptive spells, ultimately leading to a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly playing out powerful dragons and disruptive enchantments to lock down the opponent's mana base and prevent them from casting spells effectively. By utilizing cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while continuing to apply pressure with aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck also includes versatile removal spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption to deal with any threats the opponent may have. Overall, the strategy revolves around locking down the opponent's resources while hitting hard and fast with dragons and other creatures.
